Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
Mask of 1k Faces:

Only usable by a ready, untapped vampire other than the acting minion (who
is capable of performing the action). Untap the acting minion and tap this
vampire instead. Now this vampire is the acting minion. The action resumes
where it left off.

SUP: As above, with +1 stealth.

Seduction:

Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. Choose a younger
vampire. He or she cannot block the acting vampire.

SUP: As above, but the affected vampire can be the same age or older.

Now the question is; can I play Seduction, then Mask with another vamp and
then Seduct with him?

Roger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> Seduction: Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced...

> Now the question is; can I play Seduction, then Mask with another vamp and
> then Seduct with him?

No. Seduction must be played when the action is announced.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
>
> "LSJ" <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message
> news:3BE69AFE...@white-wolf.com...
> > Roger Carhult wrote:
> > > Seduction: Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced...
> > > Now the question is; can I play Seduction, then Mask with another vamp
> and
> > > then Seduct with him?
> >
> > No. Seduction must be played when the action is announced.
>
> But couldn't yu argue that since MAsk resumes where the action left off,
> you're still in the announcement phase and thus can play another Seduction?

No. Mask is not an "as announced" effect, so by playing it, you must be
past the "as announced" part.

> How do you know you passed that step as soona s you played Seduction or
> Mask?

When you play Mask, you've passed it. You're no longer announcing the action.
